deficiencies.description: The rewrite adds 'illustrates this', linking the stained slice of a tumour to the preceding statement about explanting a tumour, which the lecturer did not state.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: often they will explant the tumor. Here you're looking at a slice through a tumor and a stain to look at the morphology.
deficiencies.studentHarm: A student might incorrectly learn that a stained histological slice through a tumour illustrates the process or result of explanting a tumour.
